# Humberto Wilfredo Henríquez Benítez

> Power Platform architect and senior React developer. His practice covers data, automation and applied AI. Works remotely from San Salvador, El Salvador.

## Personal website

- [Home and ways to collaborate](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/#colaboracion): technical profile, team collaboration and working arrangements.
- [Professional profile](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/perfil/): education, career and professional approach.
- [Technical cases](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/perfil/#proyectos): Oficina Viva, Capturista Digital and data consolidation, with the scope of each case.
- [Laboratory](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/laboratorio/): 20 automatic demonstrations with synthetic data. They do not represent commercial outcomes achieved for clients.
- [Visual exploration](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/laboratorio/cosmos/): an artistic, interactive interpretation of the cosmos; a creative experience separate from the professional profile.
- [Publications](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/publicaciones/): technical perspectives and articles authored by Humberto.
- [Contact](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/#contacto): external collaboration, defined projects and fully remote employment opportunities.

- [Professional pack](https://inghumbertohenriquez.com/en/colaboracion/): one-page summary, current ES/EN CVs, three own-project/demonstration cases, code review guide and engagement terms. Working-hour overlap, time commitment and language are agreed for each international engagement.

## Professional services through Optimatiza

- [Ongoing support](https://optimatiza.com/en/acompanamiento-tecnologico/#continuidad): development, maintenance and improvement of solutions with shared priorities.
- [Support for consulting firms](https://optimatiza.com/en/acompanamiento-tecnologico/#consultoras): senior collaboration within the team on Power Platform, data and automation.

Employment opportunities are discussed directly with Humberto. Professional services are managed through Optimatiza. Time commitment, start date, scope and terms are agreed on a case-by-case basis. This website does not advertise immediate availability, fixed rates or Microsoft Partner credentials.

- [Power Platform architecture](https://optimatiza.com/en/power-platform/)
- [React and Next.js application development](https://optimatiza.com/en/aplicaciones-empresariales/#desarrollo-react-nextjs)
- [Data and Power BI](https://optimatiza.com/en/data-business-intelligence/)
- [Integration, Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 transition and training](https://optimatiza.com/en/integracion-sistemas/#migracion-google-microsoft)

## International coordination

Remote engagements can be assessed for Spain, Latin America, Spanish-speaking teams in the United States and other markets. This offer does not imply offices in those countries or unconfirmed availability. Native Spanish and written technical English; the professional pack specifies a basic level for reading technical documentation. Scope, responsibilities, working hours and capacity are agreed before starting.
